## Next Commands (3 lines)

```
aub status --lane 21b5700bf9943671
aub explore --bias oos_min --rounds 5
aub validate --run db08d79b484756ab --full
```

1. `status` — Confirm lane state and retrieve missing filename
2. `explore` — Target oos_min improvement to shore up weakest fold
3. `validate` — Full validation on current run to confirm champion legitimacy before promotion
